pages.text: SYN Business Review analyst note on Kilele Insurance (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 98.65 for KIL8. The note cites steady demand in the insurance sector and cost control at Kilele Insurance (SYN). Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
